operations:
[
 {
  "data_source": "Site DB",
  "raw_sql": "SELECT
    so.customer AS `Buyer`,
    sod.item_code AS `Style`,
    so.name AS `OCN`,
    cc.PCD AS `PCD`,
    so.delivery_date AS `Delivery Date`,
    sod.qty AS `Order Quantity`,
    COALESCE(cci.`Cut Quantity`, 0) AS `Cut Quantity`,
    (sod.qty - COALESCE(cci.`Cut Quantity`, 0)) AS `Cut Balance against Order Qty`
FROM `tabSales Order` so
JOIN `tabSales Order Item` sod
  ON sod.parent = so.name
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT sales_order, MAX(DATE(modified)) AS PCD
    FROM `tabCan Cut`
    GROUP BY sales_order
) cc ON cc.sales_order = so.name
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT sales_order, SUM(confirmed_quantity) AS `Cut Quantity`
    FROM `tabCut Confirmation Item`
    GROUP BY sales_order
) cci ON cci.sales_order = so.name
WHERE so.docstatus = 1
ORDER BY so.delivery_date ASC",
  "type": "sql"
 }
]
